einzeiler: Documentary filmmaker Eric Goode discusses his life, career, and conservation work.
kurzfassung: Eric Goode talks about growing up in an animal-filled home and his experiences in 1980s New York. He discusses creating nightclubs and hotels, directing music videos, and investigating reptile smugglers to make Tiger King. Additionally, he explores themes of obsession, conservation, and complex moral landscapes.
stichpunkte: Growing up in an animal-filled home and experiencing Northern California's New Age movement
Befriending Jean-Michel Basquiat and Keith Haring in 1980s New York
Creating legendary nightclubs and hotels and directing Nine Inch Nails videos
Investigating reptile smugglers, leading to the creation of Tiger King
The role of obsession in giving life purpose
Approaches to conservation and dialogue with political opponents
The complexity of moral situations without clear villains
beschreibung:
Eric Goode (Monsters of God, Chimp Crazy, Tiger King) is a filmmaker, hotelier, and conservationist. Eric joins Armchair Expert to discuss growing up in an animal-filled home, surviving Northern California’s New Age movement, and befriending Jean-Michel Basquiat and Keith Haring in 1980s New York. Eric and Dax talk about creating legendary nightclubs and hotels, directing Nine Inch Nails videos, and stumbling into Tiger King while investigating reptile smugglers. Eric explains why obsession can give life purpose, why conservation requires talking to people you oppose, and why there is rarely one clear bad guy.
